//@version=5
// RT10 probe (never compiled here) - capture queue docs/pine/capture-queue-2026-10-03-rt10-runtime-walls.md
// Each row is ONE plot, titled by its id. Values are read per bar.
indicator("vw-rt10-runtime-walls", overlay = false, max_bars_back = 500)

// runtime state the pivots read (a reassigned var, so it is not a plain price series)
var float x = na
x := bar_index % 37 == 0 ? na : close * 2 + (bar_index % 3)

// P01-P04: pivot over runtime state at its confirmation bar (ties both sides, holes)
plot(ta.pivothigh(x, 2, 3), "P01 pivothigh(x,2,3)")
plot(ta.pivotlow(x, 2, 2), "P02 pivotlow(x,2,2)")
f(s) => ta.pivotlow(s, 1, 2)
plot(f(x), "P03 f(x) pivotlow(1,2)")
plot(f(x + 1), "P04 f(x+1) pivotlow(1,2)")
plot(x, "P00 x control")

// S01-S02: switch as a statement (first match runs, default otherwise; subject once)
var float acc = 0.0
switch bar_index % 4
    0 => acc := acc + 1
    1 => acc := acc + 10
    1 => acc := acc + 1000
    => acc := acc + 100
plot(acc, "S01 switch with subject")
var float hits = 0.0
switch ta.barssince(close > open)
    0 => hits := hits + 1
    1 => hits := hits + 10
    2 => hits := hits + 100
plot(hits, "S02 stateful subject once")

// H01-H03: an expression's own series inside a function
g(v, n) => ta.sma(v * volume, n)
plot(g(x, 4), "H01 sma(v*volume,n) in f")
h(v) => (v + 1)[2]
plot(h(x), "H02 (v+1)[2] in f")
k(v) => ta.change(v * 2)
plot(k(x), "H03 change(v*2) in f")

// C01: ta.cum over runtime state (na before the first finite input, na ON an na bar, total held)
plot(ta.cum(x), "C01 cum(x)")
